title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Nottingham (NG2) Office-based Permanent, full-time Salary

About the Company

Our client is a long-established manufacturer and supplier of precision instrumentation and industrial products, serving a loyal customer base of distributors, OEMs and end users across the UK and Europe. Their range includes pressure gauges and accessories, air preparation equipment and a wide selection of electrical test and connection products.

The Role

Due to continued growth, our client is looking for a proactive Internal Sales Executive to join their office-based sales team. The focus of the role is outbound business development: building a pipeline by calling new, existing and lapsed customers, understanding their requirements and converting opportunities into orders.

You will be the first point of contact for many customers, so confidence on the phone and the ability to build relationships quickly are essential. An electrical or technical background would be a real advantage, as you will be helping customers choose the right products for their application. Full product training will be provided.

Product Range
- Pressure gauges and accessories, including diaphragm seals, snubbers, siphons and isolation valves.
- Air preparation equipment, including filters, regulators, lubricators and related pneumatic components.
- Electrical products, including test clips, test leads, connectors, battery clamps and insulators.

Key Responsibilities
- Make a high volume of proactive outbound calls to new, existing and lapsed customers to generate new business.
- Identify and qualify new opportunities, and build and manage a healthy sales pipeline.
- Reactivate dormant accounts and grow spend with existing customers through cross-selling and upselling across the full product range.
- Handle inbound enquiries by phone and email, understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable products.
- Prepare accurate quotations and follow them up proactively to convert them into orders.
- Process orders and keep customers informed on pricing, stock and delivery.
- Keep CRM records up to date with all calls, quotes, opportunities and customer information.
- Work closely with the technical, customer service and field sales teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.
- Work towards weekly and monthly targets for calls, quotations and sales.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven experience in an internal sales, telesales or business development role, ideally in a B2 B environment.
- Confident making outbound calls and comfortable generating new business.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a professional telephone manner.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when preparing quotations and processing orders.
- Organised, self-motivated and target-driven.
- Competent with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

Desirable
- An electrical background, whether through qualifications, an apprenticeship or previous work as an electrician or in electrical wholesale or distribution.
- Experience selling technical, engineering or industrial products.
- Knowledge of instrumentation, pneumatics or electrical test and connection products.
- Experience selling to distributors, OEMs or trade customers.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with an earlier finish on Fridays. The role is fully office-based in Nottingham.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Nottingham
£28,000 - £35,000 Commission (on average £10k)
Full time, Permanent

Do you enjoy working in sales but dread cold calling?

Maybe your sales role is mostly transactional and you want to work in a consultative sales role.

This is not a quick win sales role, you will contact warm leads where the end user has requested contact.

Our client is a reputable business, offering reassurance to consumers within the healthcare space. They are looking for an empathetic, personable and commercially minded Sales Account Manager to join their commercial team.

This is a consultative, relationship-led sales role with an emphasis on nurturing inbound enquiries, proactively following up warm leads, identifying upselling opportunities and building strong customer relationships, rather than heavy cold calling.

Whether you are currently working in a sales executive, sales support, account management, internal sales or a commercially focused customer service role, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your sales career within a business where delivering an exceptional customer experience is just as important as achieving commercial results.

The role
- Manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities, taking ownership of the customer journey from initial enquiry through to conversion.
- Build strong customer relationships through active listening, empathy and effective communication, delivering a professional and reassuring customer experience.
- Understand individual customer needs, clearly explain relevant services, packages and pricing, and help customers make informed decisions.
- Proactively follow up warm, existing and dormant leads, maintaining regular contact and effectively managing your sales pipeline.
- Identify appropriate upselling and cross-selling opportunities, address customer concerns and confidently progress conversations towards a sale.
- Maintain accurate customer records, sales opportunities, follow-up dates and communications within their CRM.
- Take ownership of all associated sales administration, including preparing customer documentation, recording information and ensuring accurate departmental handovers.
- Resolve customer queries and appropriately escalate any safeguarding concerns.
- Work collaboratively with internal departments, supporting colleagues and contributing to wider sales, marketing and business development activities.
- Work towards agreed individual and team commercial objectives, supporting accurate reporting of pipeline, conversion and sales performance.
- Identify recurring issues and contribute ideas to improve sales processes, automation and the overall customer journey.
- Ensure all activities comply with company procedures, quality standards and confidentiality requirements, maintaining accurate and auditable customer records and working within your level of training and authority.

The candidate
- A highly empathetic and personable approach, with strong emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust and lasting customer relationships.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to listen, understand individual customer needs and adapt your communication style.
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to identify and convert sales opportunities without being pushy.
- Confidence speaking with customers over the telephone and proactively following up enquiries and sales opportunities.
- Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple customers and changing priorities.
- Good IT skills and confidence in learning CRM systems, with an appreciation of the importance of accurate sales administration.
- A proactive, accountable approach, with the ability to use your initiative, take ownership and work independently.
- A collaborative mindset and a genuine commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and improving ways of working.

In return
- £28,000 - £35,000 per annum, depending on experience (negotiable)
- Additional bonus (up to £10,000 OTE)
- Monday to Friday working hours.
- 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Contributory company pension.
- Life insurance.
- Free on-site parking.
- Applicable company benefits.
- Opportunity to develop your sales and wider commercial experience.
- Exposure to a growing portfolio of specialist healthcare services.

If you are a relationship-focused, commercially minded individual who enjoys helping customers, identifying opportunities and delivering a genuinely consultative sales experience, we would love to hear from you.

Interested? Click 'apply' today!
